assessment.name: Involved-Blockers
assessment.description: Identifies personality attributes that are preventing you from realizing your full involvement and leadership potential.
assessment.instructions:
Instructions:

In responding to each statement, think about a typical work day or work week, and rate your agreement with each statement. Please respond honestly to each question and please note, that some items might be similar to other items, this is intentional.

questions.content: I worry about unknown situations or tasks
I worry that I will do the wrong things at work.
I am afraid that people will find fault with my work
My friends have told me that I let fear get in my way sometimes
I avoid situations where I might perform poorly
I am afraid that people will find fault with my  performance
Fear can sometimes slow me down
I rarely worry about what kind of impression I make at work
I am generally courageous and comfortable when facing obstacles
I prefer to learn from new work tasks than let fear of failure slow me down
I usually know more than other people in the room
Given my background, I have more expertise than others I work with
My knowledge and expertise exceeds most other people I know
My friends tell me I am headstrong
Over the years, people have told me I am 'thick-headed'
I have been known to plow ahead with plans, not taking into account other people's ideas/suggestions
More often than not, I am usually correct, and I let people know it
Most things that go wrong are easily justifiable
I quickly rationalize negative events to make myself look/feel better
More often than not, I can easily pinpoint the reason something went wrong
When someone messes up, they usually justify their actions to save face
When bad things happen, it is because someone else messed up
Most people blame others when things go bad
I try to find the real reason for someone's success or failure
I am often blamed by others at work when things wrong
Where I work, it is usually the messenger who is blamed, not the real culprit
I have been the victim of too many issues at work
I am often the victim, not the victorious, regardless of my role in a situation
I feel that I am blamed when things go wrong, regardless of what I actually did
There is always someone else to blame with things go wrong
Generally speaking, I’m more deserving of good things
I feel more entitled than most people
If I were on a sinking ship, I should be one of the first people on a life boat
Since I am worth it, I usually prefer the finer things in life
I deserve the best
People similar to me deserve special breaks
I am more deserving of everything good in life
